rule_in_plain_language: 3 or more consecutive loss years, related-party charges in each
legal_source: Income Tax Act; perpetual loss carry-over
lawful_explanations: Start-up phase; expansion; market downturn; genuine group services
what_officer_must_establish: Are the group charges genuine and correctly treated? Are losses being created in-house?
documents_to_request: Services agreement; Basis of charge; Board minutes

rule_in_plain_language: P01 true and related-party loans rise every loss year
lawful_explanations: Parent investing for long-term growth; genuine turnaround plan
what_officer_must_establish: How are losses funded, and what does the group gain?

rule_in_plain_language: Fee growth minus revenue growth >= 25 points; fees >= M500,000
legal_source: Income Tax Act s.113 (allocation only; AfriSam v LRA 2026)
lawful_explanations: New systems; restructuring; expanded services from the parent
what_officer_must_establish: What services were delivered, and how was the charge set?
documents_to_request: Services agreement; Invoices; Proof of services delivered; Basis of charge

rule_in_plain_language: WHT gross on a payment type < 80% of the amount in the return; amount >= M200,000
legal_source: Income Tax Act s.107; WHT Public Ruling
lawful_explanations: Payee is resident; treaty exemption; timing of payment
what_officer_must_establish: Was withholding tax due on these payments, and was it paid?

rule_in_plain_language: Rate below 25% to a payee the group register places in a non-treaty country
lawful_explanations: Payee genuinely resident in a treaty country
what_officer_must_establish: Is the payee entitled to the treaty rate?

rule_in_plain_language: Services paid to non-residents >= M200,000 and reverse-charge VAT < 50% of 15%
lawful_explanations: Services exempt or outside scope; timing differences
what_officer_must_establish: Was VAT on imported services declared and paid?

rule_in_plain_language: Credits in 3 or more of last 6 months; then check sales and inputs vs Lekuka (10%), import VAT vs customs (5%), imported-services input vs reverse-charge output
lawful_explanations: Zero-rated sales or exports; stock build-up; capital investment
what_officer_must_establish: Do the claims match invoices and trading activity?

rule_in_plain_language: Management fee paid every month for 12+ months with variation under 2%
lawful_explanations: Genuine short project; specialist skills unavailable locally
what_officer_must_establish: Consultancy or employment? Present more than 182 days in 12 months? Is remuneration borne by the Lesotho business?
documents_to_request: Services agreement; Who performed the services; Payroll records; Housing and vehicle records

rule_in_plain_language: Raised only from taxpayer documents (housing, vehicles for expatriates)
lawful_explanations: Benefits paid and taxed abroad; treaty relief
documents_to_request: Housing and vehicle records; Payroll records

rule_in_plain_language: Any payment to a related entity flagged low-tax in the group register
lawful_explanations: Genuine operations or services located there
what_officer_must_establish: What are the payments for, and how do they affect Lesotho's tax base?
documents_to_request: Services agreement; Certificate of residence; Group structure

rule_in_plain_language: Related interest >= M500,000 and >= 30% of result before interest (or that result <= 0)
lawful_explanations: Genuine funding needs on commercial terms
what_officer_must_establish: Is the loan genuine, and are its terms appropriate? Was WHT withheld on interest?

rule_in_plain_language: Revenue up and profit at or below half of prior year (prior year profitable)
lawful_explanations: Investment (depreciation, financing); price competition; one-off costs
what_officer_must_establish: What explains the fall in profit?

rule_in_plain_language: Related charges but no financial statements, or payee missing from group register
what_officer_must_establish: Obtain the missing records before drawing any conclusion
documents_to_request: Financial statements; Group structure; Services agreement

rule_in_plain_language: A VAT figure more than 4x the company's monthly median
what_officer_must_establish: Does the figure match the source return?
documents_to_request: (internal check of the source return; no taxpayer request)
